name: P-fastapi__full-stack-fastapi-template-why-1
answer_head:
- **The endpoint reads the password from the body.** `reset_password` takes `body: NewPassword` (`backend/app/api/routes/login.py:77-78`). `NewPassword` is a model class at `backend/app/models.py:131`.
- **It was moved from the query string to the body on purpose, for security.** Commit `546dc8b` ("
